args.title: Halvorsen Supply: Freight pricing this quarter (article + companion)
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices (rather than a fixed lag).
- Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.

Source: Halvorsen Supply newsletter "Freight pricing this quarter" → https://blog.halvorsen.example/2026/freight, companion piece: https://insights.halvorsen.example/freight/companion
